newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICAN DAILY PORT, SHIPPING UPDATE FOR AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: MEXICAN DAILY PORT, SHIPPING UPDATE FOR AUG 8.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Friday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
In the Gulf of Mexico a cold front was drawing winds and rains to Chihuahua state, with rains expected later in the day on the coasts of Campeche, Tabasco and southern Veracruz.
Isolated rains and wind gusts were reported along the coasts of Honduras, Belize, Panama, Costa Rica and Nicaragua.

Strong rains and thunder showers in Oaxaca from a regional tropical storm, and moderate rains reported in Chiapas. Winds in the area from 15 to 20 knots (16 to 22 miles/19 to 29 km per hour) with waves four to seven feet.
